```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
births <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx")
glimpse(births)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
births_tibble <- read_excel("data/us_births_1994_2014.xlsx") |>
  mutate(day_of_week = factor(
    day_of_week,
    levels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tues", "Wed", "Thurs", "Fri", "Sat"),
    ordered = TRUE
  ))
```

```{r}
average_births_by_date <- births_tibble |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(average_births = mean(births), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(average_births_by_date, aes(x = date_of_month, y = month, fill = average_births)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = 1:12, labels = month.name) +
  labs(x = "Day of month", y = "Month", fill = "Mean births")
```

```{r}
christmas_births_by_year <- births_tibble |>
  filter(month == 12) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(
    births_dec_25 = births[date_of_month == 25],
    christmas_weekday = day_of_week[date_of_month == 25],
    surrounding_day_average = mean(
      births[date_of_month %in% c(20:24, 27:30)]
    ),
    pct_of_baseline = births_dec_25 / surrounding_day_average * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

christmas_births_by_year |> print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
ggplot(christmas_births_by_year, aes(x = year, y = pct_of_baseline)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(aes(color = christmas_weekday)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "December 25 births (% of baseline)",
    color = "Weekday"
  )
```

```{r}
births_model <- lm(births ~ year + month + day_of_week, data = births_tibble)
summary(births_model)$r.squared
```

```{r}
births_adjusted <- births_tibble |>
  mutate(pct_resid = residuals(births_model) / mean(births) * 100)

calendar_resid <- births_adjusted |>
  filter(!(month == 2 & date_of_month == 29)) |>
  group_by(month, date_of_month) |>
  summarise(mean_pct_resid = mean(pct_resid), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(calendar_date = as.Date(sprintf("2001-%02d-%02d", month, date_of_month))) |>
  select(calendar_date, month, date_of_month, mean_pct_resid)

calendar_resid |> print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
holiday_dips <- calendar_resid |>
  filter(calendar_date %in% as.Date(c(
    "2001-01-01", "2001-07-04", "2001-12-24", "2001-12-25"
  ))) |>
  mutate(
    holiday = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ "New Year's Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ "Independence Day",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ "Christmas Eve",
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ "Christmas"
    ),
    label_date = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ as.Date("2001-01-05"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ as.Date("2001-07-08"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ as.Date("2001-10-20"),
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ as.Date("2001-11-15")
    ),
    label_hjust = 0,
    label_y = case_when(
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-01-01") ~ -34,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-07-04") ~ -30,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-24") ~ -34,
      calendar_date == as.Date("2001-12-25") ~ -48
    )
  )

ggplot(calendar_resid, aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray50") +
  geom_line() +
  geom_segment(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = calendar_date, y = mean_pct_resid, xend = label_date, yend = label_y),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "gray40"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = holiday_dips,
    aes(x = label_date, y = label_y, label = holiday, hjust = label_hjust),
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(x = "Calendar date", y = "Mean residual (% of overall mean)")
```
